name: Curfew-Blaze
description: Curfew-Blaze earned its name from the periodic resurfacing events that engulf the entire planet in fresh lava flows, effectively imposing a curfew on all surface activity. Between these cataclysmic events, the world is a landscape of cooling volcanic glass plains and chains of lava lakes that glow like molten amber.

The atmosphere is a dense toxic shroud of volcanic gases that traps heat with ruthless efficiency. The air shimmers with thermal distortion, and the horizon seems to writhe and pulse as convection currents battle across the scorched surface.

Remarkably, microbial life has adapted to this cycle of destruction and renewal. The organisms retreat deep into rock fissures during resurfacing events and emerge to recolonize the fresh mineral-rich surfaces within days, a pattern of death and rebirth that has repeated for millions of years.

The platinum and titanium deposits exposed by each resurfacing event are enormously valuable, but the unpredictable timing of the cataclysms means any mining operation must be prepared for rapid evacuation. Several automated facilities have been lost, their wreckage now buried under kilometers of fresh basalt.
